blocks.body:
Scissors over comb, a clean fade, a beard that follows the jaw instead of fighting it. I learned in a barbershop in Basel and kept the habits: hot towel, straight lines, no small talk unless you want it.

I cut children too — the ones who sit still and the ones who do not. Come in on a weekday morning if you can; Saturdays are the busiest chair in the room.
blocks.title: Jonas Brunner
